jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent PNG 2D overworld building sprite atlas for a Chinese cultivation RPG.
Primary request: Create exactly FOUR isolated building cutouts arranged in a precise 2 by 2 grid on a truly transparent square canvas. Request 2048 by 2048 native pixels; use the largest clear native square image available. Each quadrant contains ONE complete independent sprite, centered horizontally with its ground-contact baseline at about 87 percent of that quadrant height. Keep a fully transparent gutter at least 80 pixels at the central vertical and horizontal seams, generous exterior transparent padding, and never let one sprite cross into another quadrant.
Shared art direction: traditional Chinese handpainted ink-and-muted-watercolor game art. Restrained fine dark umber / warm graphite contours with gentle broken brush texture; warm ivory plaster and aged ochre stone; weathered muted brown timber; desaturated gray-jade and slate roof tiles. Pigment has small paper-grain variation INSIDE the architecture only. Crisp coherent edges and readable larger architectural forms, no heavy cartoon outlines, no miniature busy roof crosshatching. Similar fidelity to a finely painted pale-jade wooden spirit boat and bare ochre-gray Chinese landscape mountains. Frontal orthographic view with only a little roof-top depth visible, no exaggerated isometric side face, no lens perspective. Every sprite in the atlas uses exactly the same view angle, brush weight, native-detail scale, and soft ambient lighting.
Every building must read as a distinct usable place, its front entrance plainly visible. Base is the actual building footing; no landscape backdrop or base tile. Solid opaque building surfaces and genuine transparent openings where one can see through. Preserve individual supports and clear gaps. Maximum useful building detail rather than decorative noise.
All remaining pixels must be truly transparent, with NO haze, halo, glow, shadow, gradient, checkerboard pattern, colored panel, terrain wash, fog or paper background. Do not paint ANY text, pseudo-writing, plaques with writing, captions, numerals, seals, logos, UI, framing, people, animals, vegetation, mountains, smoke, or sky. No giant ornamental pedestal. Four architecture assets only.

CRITICAL LAYOUT PRIORITY: These are FOUR SMALL SEPARATE CUTOUTS in four LARGE EMPTY cells. Shrink every building so its entire width is at most 68 percent of its cell width, and its height at most 72 percent of the cell height. Leave at least 16 percent transparent margin at BOTH the left and right of EACH cell. In a 1254px canvas this means buildings no wider than 425px, with at least 100px blank margins at every outer edge and at least 180px total blank gutter through the center. Center each sprite in its quadrant; no roof can touch an outer edge or a grid seam. Empty transparent area is intentional. Complete eave tips are more important than filling canvas. Never enlarge a broad building to fill the sheet.
